scenario_title: Producer shipped a new event schema before the consumer
title: Processing errors on billing-svc

detection.alert: billing-svc: error-log rate > 20/min (CloudWatch Logs metric filter)

impact: Background processing failed; customer-visible data was delayed or wrong on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-06-26 19:59-00:39: billing-svc: 303 of 435 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-06-26 19:59 and 2026-06-27 00:39 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.consumer.UsageEventConsumer - failed to parse usage event: UnrecognizedPropertyException: Unrecognized field "flavor" (class UsageEvent)
c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of cloud-api started publishing the v2 usage-event schema (FEAT-124) before billing-svc could read it; billing-svc rejected every event and the usage queue backed up into the DLQ.
_templates.micro: {file}:{line} ({symbol}) replaces the instance_type field with a nested flavor object.
_templates.remediation: Roll back cloud-api {version_to} -> {version_from}; redrive the DLQ after billing-svc accepts both schemas; deploy consumers before producers.

culprit.diff:
@@ -126,5 +126,5 @@ UsagePublisher.publish
         event = {
             "account_id": server.tenant,
-            "instance_type": server.flavor.name,
+            "flavor": {"name": server.flavor.name, "vcpus": server.flavor.vcpus},
             "hours": hours,
         }

rca.macro: Deploy v3.31.0 of cloud-api started publishing the v2 usage-event schema (FEAT-124) before billing-svc could read it; billing-svc rejected every event and the usage queue backed up into the DLQ.
rca.micro: cloud-api/nova/usage/publisher.py:128 (UsagePublisher.publish) replaces the instance_type field with a nested flavor object.
rca.remediation: Roll back cloud-api v3.31.0 -> v3.30.0; redrive the DLQ after billing-svc accepts both schemas; deploy consumers before producers.

action_items: Add a regression test covering UsagePublisher.publish (cloud-api/nova/usage/publisher.py).
Alert on the error signature `c.f.b.consumer.UsageEventConsumer - message <*> returned to queue (receive <*>`.
